name: Bionic Reading & Fonts
author: patatasbravasch-arch
description: Bionic reading, typography, toolbar controls, FF think fix, LumiRealm compatibility, persistent saved preferences, and configurable auto-regeneration. Auto Regenerate watches completed assistant replies for user-defined trigger text and invokes Lumiverse's native Regenerate action with a retry limit. FF think fix can move either text before or text after the chosen boundary marker into native reasoning.
